title: OUF Gateway Publication Manifest v1
description: Minimal evidence of controlled Gateway configuration publication and verification.
x-ouf-scope-control: Gateway boundary/runtime contracts only. No Query Complexity Governor, fine-grained data authorization, Durable ACK authority, schema-drift classification, ETL, semantic processing, Object Resolution, UDP materialization, THS decision logic or MCP Server implementation.
x-ouf-note: Gateway v1.2 freezes the publication sequence and ACTIVE/verification semantics, but not an exhaustive manifest DTO. This is a minimal evidence schema.
x-ouf-invariants: Git/config submission does not equal ACTIVE
ACTIVE only after validate/compile/controlled update/propagation verification
control-plane degradation blocks new ACTIVE publication
last-known-good data-plane configuration may continue serving where verified by adopted APISIX version
